title_zh: 苹果官宣 10 月 13 日发布新品、首款触屏 MacBook Pro 月底亮相
content_zh:
今天，苹果营销高级副总裁 Greg Joswiak 发布预告，宣布苹果将于美国东部时间 10 月 13 日进行「Welcome home（欢迎回家）」新品发布。根据媒体获得的邀请函，活动定于当地时间 9 点进行，北京时间为 13 日晚 9 点。

另据彭博社报道，苹果计划于 10 月 27 日前后推出首款触屏 MacBook Pro 和新款 iPad mini，发布形式包括线上视频和面向媒体的线下体验。同期亮相的产品还包括搭载 M6 芯片的 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 和 iMac。

新款高端 MacBook Pro 将提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸版本，配备 OLED 屏幕并支持触控，机身较现款更轻薄，界面还将加入 iPhone 用户熟悉的「灵动岛」。

新款 iPad mini 则将采用 OLED 屏幕，但刷新率仍保持 60Hz。前置摄像头移至横向一侧，并更新扬声器系统。
title_en: Apple Announces October 13 Event; First Touchscreen MacBook Pro Expected Late October
content_en:
Apple has officially announced a "Welcome home" product launch event scheduled for October 13 at 9:00 AM ET, according to a teaser shared by Greg Joswiak, Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing.

In addition to the October 13 event, Bloomberg reports that Apple plans to unveil its highly anticipated first-ever touchscreen MacBook Pro and a new iPad mini around October 27. This late-October rollout will feature online video presentations alongside in-person hands-on experiences for the media. Other expected announcements include a new iMac and a 14-inch MacBook Pro, both powered by the next-generation M6 chip.

The upcoming premium MacBook Pro lineup, available in 14-inch and 16-inch models, will reportedly sport thinner and lighter chassis, OLED touchscreens, and the iPhone's signature "Dynamic Island" interface. Meanwhile, the refreshed iPad mini is expected to transition to an OLED display (retaining a 60Hz refresh rate), feature a landscape-oriented front camera, and include an upgraded speaker system.

title_zh: 曝三星手机业务四季度最高减产 30%，内存涨价压缩利润
content_zh:
据韩国 MoneyToday 报道，三星电子移动体验事业部（MX）已通知供应商，计划在 2026 年第四季度把智能手机供应量削减 20% 至 30%。三

多位业内消息人士称，内存价格持续上涨后，手机产品利润已非常微薄，部分产品甚至可能亏损，减产是保护整体盈利水平的方式。

TrendForce 数据显示，2026 年第二季度 12GB LPDDR5X 手机内存价格约为 145 至 146 美元，同比上涨 175%；第三季度价格预计环比继续上涨约 20%，最高可能达到 180 美元。

三星此前预计全年手机产量最高可达 2.7 亿部，减产后全年产量或落在 2 亿部出头；公司计划于 10 月 29 日公布第三季度详细业绩。
title_en: Samsung to Cut Q4 Smartphone Production by Up to 30% Amid Surging Memory Costs
content_en:
Samsung Electronics' Mobile Experience (MX) division has reportedly notified suppliers of plans to slash smartphone production by 20% to 30% in the fourth quarter of 2026. The decision comes as soaring memory prices severely squeeze profit margins, leaving some mobile products near or below profitability.

According to market research firm TrendForce, the price of 12GB LPDDR5X mobile memory reached approximately $145 to $146 in Q2 2026, representing a staggering 175% year-on-year increase. Prices are projected to climb another 20% in the third quarter, potentially peaking at $180.

While Samsung initially targeted an annual output of up to 270 million smartphones, the impending production cuts could drag the full-year volume down to just over 200 million units. The tech giant is scheduled to disclose its detailed third-quarter financial results on October 29.

title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast，速度最高提升至 8 倍
content_zh:
今天，OpenAI 官宣推出 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Ultrafast 版本，覆盖 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work。OpenAI 称，该版本的智能水平接近 Astra，速度最高可达 Sol Standard 的 8 倍。

价格方面，GPT-6.1 Sol 标准版 API 定价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 10 美元；Ultrafast 版本则为每百万输入 token 12 美元、输出 token 60 美元。

Ultrafast 在 API 端可按量付费使用；Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 端目前仅向 Pro 500 订阅用户、符合条件的 Enterprise 按量付费用户及 Edu 用户开放。
title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast with Up to 8x Speed Boost
content_en:
OpenAI has officially released GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast, a high-speed variant of its model now available across its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work platforms. According to OpenAI, the new model delivers intelligence close to its Astra model while performing up to eight times faster than the standard GPT-6.1 Sol.

The significant speed boost comes with a premium price tag. While the standard GPT-6.1 Sol API costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, the Ultrafast version is priced at $12 per million input tokens and $60 per million output tokens.

For API developers, the Ultrafast model is available on a pay-as-you-go basis. However, access within Codex and ChatGPT Work is currently restricted to Pro 500 subscribers, eligible pay-as-you-go Enterprise clients, and Education users.

title_zh: 联想 YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark 开启中国市场预售，10 月 16 日开售
content_zh:
联想 10 月 8 日宣布，YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark（海外型号 Yoga Pro 9n）在中国市场开启全网预售，10 月 16 日正式开售。这是全球首批搭载英伟达 RTX Spark N1X 芯片的 AI PC 之一，面向 AI 开发者、专业创作者和高性能计算用户。

该机最高配备 128GB 统一内存和 2TB SSD，采用最高 20 核 NVIDIA Grace CPU、6144 个 CUDA 核心的 Blackwell RTX GPU，FP4 AI 峰值算力最高可达 1 PFLOPS；联想称，设备支持在本地运行超过千亿参数模型，并预装 35B 本地大模型和天禧 AI 超能模式。RTX Spark 平台通过 CPU、GPU 共享统一内存，减少传统独立显存容量对本地模型部署的限制。
title_en: Lenovo YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark AI PC Opens for Pre-Orders in China, Shipping Oct 16
content_en:
Lenovo has officially opened pre-orders in China for its YOGA Pro 15 RTX Spark (known globally as the Yoga Pro 9n), with official sales set to begin on October 16. Positioned as one of the world's first AI PCs powered by the NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X chip, the laptop targets AI developers, professional creators, and high-performance computing (HPC) users.

The powerhouse machine can be configured with up to 128GB of unified memory and a 2TB SSD. It features an NVIDIA Grace CPU with up to 20 cores and a Blackwell-architecture RTX GPU boasting 6,144 CUDA cores, delivering peak FP4 AI performance of up to 1 PFLOPS.

According to Lenovo, the device is capable of running local AI models with over 100 billion parameters. It comes pre-loaded with a 35-billion-parameter local large language model (LLM) and Lenovo's Tianxi AI Super Mode. By utilizing a unified memory architecture shared between the CPU and GPU, the RTX Spark platform overcomes the traditional VRAM limitations that often hinder local model deployment.

title_zh: Vidu Q4 Preview 开放，支持 15 张参考图和 4K 输出
content_zh:
Vidu AI 10 月 8 日开放 Vidu Q4 Preview，定位为新一代视频生成模型预览版。它最多支持 3 段参考音频、15 张参考图，以及 2K、4K 输出，重点强化人物表演、动态运镜、镜头衔接和复杂视效。

Vidu 同时公布首发优惠价 0.09 元/秒起，并称 Q4 Preview 将继续与创作者共创。官方示例覆盖参考图、参考音频、文生视频和图生视频等流程；价格为首发优惠，完整价格政策以官网为准。
title_en: Vidu AI Launches Q4 Preview Video Model with 4K Output and Multi-Image Reference Support
content_en:
Vidu AI has officially launched the preview version of its next-generation video generation model, Vidu Q4 Preview. The update introduces advanced capabilities, including support for up to 15 reference images, three reference audio tracks, and high-resolution 2K and 4K outputs.

The new model focuses on enhancing character performances, dynamic camera movements, seamless shot transitions, and complex visual effects. Vidu has also released official demonstrations showcasing workflows for text-to-video, image-to-video, and multi-modal references.

To mark the release, Vidu is offering promotional pricing starting at 0.09 RMB per second of video generation.

title_zh: 阶跃 STEPX Neo 智能体手机定档 10 月 13 日发布
content_zh:
阶跃终端宣布，首款大模型原生智能体手机 STEPX Neo 将于 10 月 13 日 19:00 发布，发布会主题为「Ready Builder One」。这款手机今年 7 月已在世界人工智能大会亮相，定位是把大模型、智能体原生系统 Step AOS 和手机硬件结合起来。

STEPX Neo 的具体芯片、售价和上市安排将于发布会公布。
title_en: StepX to Launch STEPX Neo, an LLM-Native AI Agent Phone, on October 13
content_en:
StepX has announced that its first LLM-native AI Agent smartphone, the STEPX Neo, will officially launch on October 13 at 7:00 PM (Beijing Time) under the theme "Ready Builder One."

First showcased at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) in July, the STEPX Neo is designed to deeply integrate large language models, the agent-native operating system Step AOS, and mobile hardware.

Detailed specifications, pricing, and availability of the device will be fully disclosed during the launch event.

title_zh: 《极限竞速：地平线 6》PS5 版延期至 2027 年 1 月 26 日
content_zh:
Playground Games 此前宣布《极限竞速：地平线 6》会在 2026 年登陆 PS5，如今确认主机版延期至 2027 年 1 月 26 日，并与新扩展包同日推出。PS5 Premium Edition 可提前最多 5 天游玩；Xbox 和 PC 版已于 5 月 15 日发售。

上一作《极限竞速：地平线 5》登陆 PS5 后表现突出，这次延期也让 PS5 版与新扩展内容一起上市。
title_en: Forza Horizon 6 PS5 Release Delayed to January 2027
content_en:
Playground Games has announced that the PlayStation 5 version of *Forza Horizon 6* has been delayed to January 26, 2027. The game was previously scheduled to launch on the platform sometime in 2026.

The delayed PS5 launch will now coincide with the release of a new expansion pack. Players who purchase the PS5 Premium Edition will receive up to five days of early access. Meanwhile, the Xbox and PC versions of the game have already been available since May 15.

This decision follows the strong performance of *Forza Horizon 5* on the PS5. Aligning the PS5 release of the sequel with the new expansion is expected to maximize its impact on the platform.

title_zh: 《三角洲行动》日活突破 5800 万，游戏葡萄复盘其增长路径
content_zh:
《三角洲行动》近日宣布国服日活跃用户数突破 5800 万。游戏葡萄梳理称，该游戏日活从 2025 年 4 月的 1200 万、7 月的 2000 万和一周年时的 3000 万，增长到 2026 年 3 月的 5000 万，再到二周年和国庆假期后的最新数字。

文章提到，产品运营并未只围绕传统搜打撤玩法展开：玩家可以在地图里带其他队伍进入撤离点、吹口琴或跳舞，游戏也加入钓鱼、打牌等玩法；二周年活动还推出彩蛋关卡和「群星计划」，准备为干员制作独立叙事短片，并计划打造供玩家自行布置的「GTI 小屋」。
title_en: Delta Force Hits 58 Million DAU in China: A Look at Its Growth Strategy
content_en:
Tencent's tactical shooter *Delta Force* has officially surpassed 58 million daily active users (DAU) on its Chinese server. Industry outlet *Game Grape* recently analyzed the game's impressive growth trajectory, tracing its rise from 12 million DAU in April 2025 to 50 million in March 2026, and finally to its current peak following its second anniversary and the National Day holiday.

According to the analysis, the game's success extends beyond its core extraction shooter gameplay. *Delta Force* has integrated various social and casual elements, allowing players to guide rival teams to extraction points, play the harmonica, dance, fish, and play cards within the game.

For its second anniversary, the developers introduced easter egg levels and launched "Project Star," which will feature standalone narrative shorts for its operators. Additionally, plans are underway to introduce customizable "GTI Cabins" for players, further deepening engagement.

title_zh: Omdia：2027 年高端电视出货量增长 9.3%，全球电视总出货量预计下降 1%
content_zh:
Omdia 预计，2027 年全球平均售价超过 1000 美元的高端电视出货量将同比增长 9.3%，而全球电视总出货量下降 1.0%。北美将成为高端电视增长最快的市场，出货量预计增长 21.9%。

Omdia 认为，存储和其他元器件成本上升正在挤压入门级电视利润，厂商会优先把紧张的零部件分配给高端机型。显示技术也在改变产品结构，RGB LED 背光预计到 2030 年将占全球高端电视收入的 49%。
title_en: Premium TV Shipments to Rise 9.3% in 2027 Despite Overall Market Decline, Omdia Reports
content_en:
Global shipments of premium TVs (priced above $1,000) are projected to grow by 9.3% year-over-year in 2027, according to research firm Omdia. In contrast, overall global TV shipments are expected to decline by 1.0% during the same period. North America is set to lead this premium segment growth, with shipments forecasted to surge by 21.9%.

Omdia attributes this trend to rising costs for memory and other critical components, which are squeezing profit margins on entry-level models. As a result, manufacturers are prioritizing their limited component supply for high-end, high-margin TVs.

Advancements in display technology are also reshaping the market. Omdia projects that RGB LED backlighting will become a dominant force, accounting for 49% of global premium TV revenue by 2030.

title_zh: 《赛博朋克 2077》将由派拉蒙开发真人电影
content_zh:
派拉蒙影业正在开发一部设定于《赛博朋克 2077》世界观中的真人电影，项目由游戏开发商 CD Projekt Red 参与，Lorenzo di Bonaventura 担任制片人。影片将继续使用这个以科技、城市权力和身体改造为核心的未来世界，但故事和演员阵容尚未公布。

《赛博朋克 2077》及其资料片《往日之影》分别已售出超过 4000 万份和 1500 万份；CD Projekt Red 此前还与 Netflix 合作推出了同一世界观的动画剧集《赛博朋克：边缘行者》。
content_en:
Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action film set in the universe of *Cyberpunk 2077*, with game developer CD Projekt Red on board. Lorenzo di Bonaventura is set to produce the project. While the film will immerse viewers in the franchise's signature futuristic world of high technology, corporate dominance, and cybernetic enhancements, details regarding the plot and cast remain under wraps.

This adaptation follows the massive commercial success of the gaming franchise. The original *Cyberpunk 2077* game has sold over 40 million copies, while its acclaimed expansion, *Phantom Liberty*, has surpassed 15 million units. CD Projekt Red previously expanded the universe on screen with the hit Netflix anime series *Cyberpunk: Edgerunners*.

title_zh: 2026 年国庆档票房 11.65 亿元，同比下降 36%
content_zh:
国家电影局数据显示，2026 年国庆档（10 月 1 日至 7 日）全国电影票房 11.65 亿元，同比下降 36%；观影人次约 3199.4 万，平均票价 36.4 元，均低于上一年同期。国产影片票房占比 78.7%，《神探之痕迹》以约 4.2 亿元成为档期票房冠军。

档期内连续 7 天单日票房破亿元，但总观影人次比上一年减少约 1800 万。票价降到近五年国庆档最低，仍未抵消影片供给和观影意愿变化带来的影响。
title_en: China's 2026 National Day Box Office Drops 36% to 1.165 Billion Yuan
content_en:
China's box office during the 2026 National Day holiday (October 1–7) grossed 1.165 billion yuan, marking a 36% year-on-year decline, according to data from the National Film Administration. Total admissions fell to approximately 31.99 million, while the average ticket price dropped to 36.4 yuan—both lower than the same period last year. Domestic films dominated the market, accounting for 78.7% of the total box office, with *Traces of the Detective* leading the charts at approximately 420 million yuan.

Although daily box office receipts surpassed 100 million yuan for seven consecutive days, overall attendance dropped by about 18 million compared to last year. Despite ticket prices falling to a five-year low for the holiday period, the price cuts were not enough to offset the impact of a shifting film supply and declining audience interest.

title_zh: 《三国第一部：争洛阳》重新定档 10 月 17 日
content_zh:
追光动画历史权谋电影《三国第一部：争洛阳》重新定档 10 月 17 日上映，并发布「王朝末日」版预告。影片由《长安三万里》原班主创团队制作，故事从东汉末年洛阳局势动荡展开，曹操、袁绍、何进、董卓、丁原和吕布等人物陆续登场。

该片此前曾上映，片方这次重新安排档期，并在预告中继续采用汉风美学呈现三国前夜的权力变化。
title_en: Light Chaser's 'The Three Kingdoms Part One' Rescheduled for October 17
content_en:
Light Chaser Animation's historical political drama, *The Three Kingdoms Part One: Battle for Luoyang*, has been rescheduled for release on October 17. Along with the announcement, the studio released a new trailer titled 'The End of the Dynasty.' Created by the acclaimed team behind *30,000 Miles from Chang'an*, the film is set during the turbulent final years of the Eastern Han Dynasty in Luoyang, chronicling the rise of iconic historical figures such as Cao Cao, Yuan Shao, He Jin, Dong Zhuo, Ding Yuan, and Lu Bu.

Following an earlier release, the studio has strategically rescheduled the film. The latest trailer continues to showcase the film's distinct Han-style aesthetics, capturing the intense power struggles on the eve of the legendary Three Kingdoms era.
